clean.tx: wɔi wu jajɛl Kaiŋ Taso ɛ
clean.tl: On the seventh day, the old woman died, Kain Tasso's mother-in-law.

clean.tx: a kɔ viki bɛŋ thimi ɛ
clean.tl: I'm going to stretch my legs.

clean.tx: pɛ thu wɔ ilath ɛ pɛ bɛ wɔ vɛ thiɛ bol
clean.tl: People spat on him and put thorns on his head.

clean.tx: n yemaɛ ŋa kɔ mi pɛl bol
clean.tl: Do you want them to go and crack my head?
